connect.lead1: Connect your wallet to create a passport.
connect.lead2: You need a Creator ID first —

noCreator.title: No Creator ID found for this wallet.

list.empty: No passports minted from this wallet yet.

form.physicalDesc: Artwork, photography, documents, collectibles — any physical object with a seal
form.issuerRoleHint: Should match why you are registering this object (e.g. museum for works in your custody). Default follows your Creator ID prefix (C/B/P/M).
form.extraMetaHint: Optional key–value fields included in passport.json and hashed on-chain (e.g. inventory number, accession, exhibition). Keys must be non-empty to be stored.
form.skipPublicUrl: No public JSON URL — mint with an empty on-chain dataUrl. The public Verify page cannot fetch your passport from the web; only someone with your canonical passport.json file can check details and authenticity. You can add a URL later via Update hosting URLs.
form.useFolder: Use a folder on my site — after mint, the app registers …/YourHumanID.json automatically (one extra confirm in the wallet)
form.folderHint: No filename — just the folder. After mint, upload one file named ODP-YYYY-MM-NNNNNNNNN.json (your real Human ID from the success screen, same casing). The on-chain dataUrl will be your-folder/ODP-….json.
form.fullUrlHint: Exact public HTTPS URL of the file after you upload it. Use this if you already know the full path (without using the folder option above).
form.digitalWarn: ⚠ Register BEFORE sharing the original. Publish only compressed or watermarked versions after.
form.fdropFileLine1: Drop original file or click to select
form.fdropImgLine1: Drop image or click to select
form.sealLead: A seal binds this passport to the specific physical object. At least one method required.
form.nfcLead: Protocol + contract: NTAG424DNA_TT (NXP NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper) only. Non–TagTamper chips cannot be minted.
form.feeLine: This deployment (on-chain gen {gen}): Polygon gas (POL) only — no separate protocol fee. Typical ~US$0.01 (varies).
form.preModalTitle: Your passport file — confirm before minting
form.preWithUrlP1: The chain stores only a hash of your passport — not the full JSON. You must keep the canonical passport.json and host it at the dataUrl you register. If the file is missing or bytes differ from the hash, verification cannot succeed (see SPEC.md §9–§11).
form.preWithUrlP2: After mint, use Download, Share JSON file, or Copy JSON on the success screen, then upload the file to your HTTPS URL unchanged. You can update the URL later on-chain (gas only) via Update hosting URLs.
form.preSkipUrlP1: You are minting without a public JSON URL (empty on-chain dataUrl). The Verify page will not be able to load or compare your passport from the network — the record is useless for public online checks until you add a URL later.
form.preSkipUrlP2: Only someone who holds the canonical passport.json file can check details and authenticity (hash vs dataHash). Keep that file safe and share it deliberately.
form.preAckWithUrl: I understand: storing and hosting passport.json is my responsibility. Without that file at the registered URL, others cannot verify this passport.
form.preAckSkipUrl: I understand: without a public JSON URL, the Verify page cannot load my file from the web; only people with the canonical passport.json can check details and authenticity against the on-chain hash.
form.preAckErr: Check the box to confirm you understand, then continue.
form.hostingModalP1: If you use folder hosting in the form, the app registers your-folder/YourHumanID.json for you after mint. Otherwise, paste the full file URL yourself.
form.hostingModalP2: The verifier loads your URL in the browser (same as opening the link). The response must be the raw JSON bytes of the passport — not an HTML page, not a login wall, not a pretty-printed GitHub file view.
form.hostingModalP3: HTTPS is required. Use a direct file URL that returns status 200 with the file body (e.g. application/json or plain text).
form.hostingModalP4: GitHub: use the Raw URL (raw.githubusercontent.com/… or Raw button), not the repository HTML page. After pushing, wait until the raw link shows your file.
form.hostingModalP5: Your site / CDN: upload the downloaded file unchanged to any static host (object storage, Netlify, Vercel, nginx, …). The path in the URL must match where you actually put the file.
form.hostingModalP6: CORS: verification runs in the browser; the host must allow cross-origin GET from the verifier page (many public static hosts and GitHub Raw do; a misconfigured private server may block the request).
form.hostingModalP7: Bytes = truth: any change to whitespace or characters changes the SHA-256. Upload the exact file from the mint success screen unless you use tooling that reproduces the same canonical minified JSON.
form.urlModalLead: Change where passport.json and the optional image are hosted. Only the creator wallet can submit. dataHash on-chain stays the same — the file at the new URL must still match that hash. You only pay Polygon network gas (POL) in your wallet.
form.urlDataUrlLabel: Passport JSON URL (optional — leave empty to clear public URL)
form.validateFolderUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS folder URL (e.g. https://art.com/passport)
form.validateDigitalFile: Original file is required for digital objects
form.validateNfc: NFC chip UID and public key are required
form.validateSeal: Seal number and type are required
form.mintConfirmWallet: Please confirm the transaction in your wallet
form.mintUrlFail: Mint succeeded, but updating the public file URL failed. Use URLs next to this passport in the list below and set the JSON URL to:
form.mintReadHumanId: Could not read Human ID from mint receipt.
form.successShareCaption: Open Share to get a QR, the link, download the image, or send via your device.
form.successUploadWithUrl: Upload the downloaded file unchanged to this exact HTTPS URL (same bytes → hash matches dataHash):
form.successNoPublicUrl: No public JSON URL is registered on-chain. Share the downloaded passport.json only with people who must verify — only that file can be checked against dataHash. You can add a URL later via Update hosting URLs.
form.successStep2: Use Share: QR encodes odp:// + Human ID (SPEC).
form.successStep3: Make sure your Creator ID {creatorId} is published on your website and social profiles.
form.successIphoneHint: iPhone / MetaMask in-app browser: a plain download may not appear in Files. Use Share JSON file (Save to Files / iCloud) or Copy JSON, then upload the file to your host unchanged.
form.qrFail: QR library did not load (network / CDN blocked).

urlEdit.urlTooLong: Each URL must be at most 512 characters

errors.connectInProgress: Connection already in progress. Approve or reject the request in your wallet extension, then try again.
errors.walletPending: A wallet request is already open. Use the wallet extension icon in the toolbar to approve or cancel — do not click Connect again until that finishes.

noWallet.line1: No injected wallet (window.ethereum). On desktop, install
noWallet.mmHint: iPhone / Safari: there is no extension — MetaMask runs as an app with a built-in browser. This link opens the same page there so Connect works.
noWallet.fileProto: file:// — many wallets do not work on local files. Run a static server in web/ (e.g. npx serve .) or use HTTPS.
noWallet.httpsHint: Use https:// or http://localhost if needed.
